records.title: Heald Green East: the 675-home outline application
records.summary: Planning application DC/095134 proposes up to 675 homes north of Stanley Road and west of the A34. The outline application was still shown as pending when checked on 17 September 2026.

records.title: Cheadle Eco Park: what is being built on Bird Hall Lane?
records.summary: The seven-acre Bird Hall Lane development is becoming six light-industrial units with a timber structural frame; the current completion target is March 2027.

records.title: Nansen / Firs estate proposed 20mph zone
records.summary: Stockport Council is consulting on a proposed 20mph speed-limit zone across the Nansen / Firs residential estate in Heald Green. The consultation closes on 24 September 2026.

records.title: Oakwood Avenue / Beech Avenue parking proposal
records.summary: A Gatley proposal for No Waiting at Any Time restrictions near the junction after reports of blocked dropped crossings and reduced visibility. The initial consultation closes on 25 September 2026.

records.title: Three SK8 car parks that are no longer free
records.summary: Church Road in Gatley, Church Road / Woods Lane in Cheadle Hulme and Finney Lane in Heald Green became charged council car parks from 8 January 2026. Check the live tariff before travelling.

records.title: Heald Green in the Regulation 19 Local Plan
records.summary: Three Heald Green housing allocations are listed at 790, 750 and 132 homes. This is a policy stage, not planning permission, with the formal response stage next.
